method.name: standardized_euclidean_average_linkage_silhouette
method.scaling: finite-observation mean and population std (ddof=0); mean imputation
method.constant_rule: std / max_abs <= float64 epsilon (or all zero)
method.selection: maximum silhouette > N*eps; ties within N*eps prefer smaller k; otherwise k=1
method.tie_break: descending C_G, canonical JSON id, row-major linkage ties
